scenarios.title: Import and preserve source
scenarios.passCondition: Hash the owned inputs before/after import, edit, save and export; unsupported input yields a clear error.

scenarios.title: Precision edit and undo
scenarios.passCondition: Move, trim, slip, split and duplicate at known sample positions; union/source bounds and undo/redo remain exact.

scenarios.title: Room-tone crossfade
scenarios.passCondition: Overlap owned room tone, inspect curve/endpoints and audition transitions without a gap or unexplained level change.

scenarios.title: Take selection and gain stage
scenarios.passCondition: Compare two candidate lines, select one, change clip gain separately from track automation; preserve the rejected source.

scenarios.title: Routing and shared processing
scenarios.passCondition: Verify dialogue/music/effects isolation, builtin gain/highpass order and automation; reject cycles.

scenarios.title: Save/reopen and failure recovery
scenarios.passCondition: Reopen preserved IDs/settings; interrupt save and inject IO failure, then recover the previous valid state and idempotency records.

scenarios.title: Picture sync
scenarios.passCondition: Measure owned sync markers at start/middle/end and after seeks; inspect rendered sample/frame alignment independently.

scenarios.title: Repeatable stem delivery
scenarios.passCondition: Render twice with fixed settings; compare decoded PCM, range/channel alignment, hashes and manifest omissions.

scenarios.title: Story links and cue queries
scenarios.passCondition: Resolve Amenewa by stable reference and reveal every unapproved line/take, including stale sibling revisions.

scenarios.title: Shared commands and retries
scenarios.passCondition: Run equivalent UI/MCP edits; exact retry returns its receipt, changed-payload retry and stale new request fail atomically.

scenarios.title: Missing/hostile dependencies
scenarios.passCondition: Move a source, supply malformed media and escaping output paths; final export blocks and project/originals remain intact.

scenarios.title: ADR recording
scenarios.passCondition: Rehearse, record and compare owned replacement takes with device latency captured; incomplete recordings cannot become approved.

scenarios.title: Reviewed picture reconform
scenarios.passCondition: Insert five seconds, reorder/delete/duplicate shots and test spanning audio; preview/cancel/apply/undo, stale plans and ambiguity.

scenarios.title: Interchange round trip
scenarios.passCondition: Exchange an owned scene with recorded edition/options and report preserved, baked, changed and omitted entities.

scenarios.title: Spectral derivative repair
scenarios.passCondition: Repair an owned copy, retain original/parent hash, record settings and review artifacts/intelligibility.

scenarios.title: Shot-attached move
scenarios.passCondition: Move each deduplicated shot-attached sound once; preview absolute/spanning exceptions and anchored automation.

scenarios.title: Fractional time mapping
scenarios.passCondition: Check 24/25 and accepted fractional frame rates at long and half-sample boundaries; reject unsupported drop-frame/VFR inputs.
